summary: Review AI and LLM evaluations for contamination, prompt dependence, judge dependence, repeated-sample dependence and benchmark scope.

must_inspect.why: Prompt variants and repeated generations can create dependence that invalidates naive sample counts.
false_positive_guards: Repeated generations are not automatically invalid; match uncertainty to the independent unit.

must_inspect.why: Model-as-judge results inherit judge calibration, bias and prompt sensitivity.
false_positive_guards: A model judge can be useful when calibrated; do not reject it categorically.

must_inspect.why: Benchmark familiarity and data contamination can weaken generalization claims.
false_positive_guards: Do not claim contamination without evidence; mark it as a verification gap.
Do not convert benchmark score differences into broad capability claims without scope support.
